notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). Constructor arguments are $factory (address), $poolManager (address, required to equal the fixed mainnet PoolManager) and $launchNumber (uint64); there are no application contracts. The constructor mints the entire fixed supply to the calling launch factory; the factory distributes 10% through its Merkle distributor, seeds up to 90% single-sided through PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and forwards rounding remainder to the specified burn address. The mandatory pool fee 3000 (0.30%) and tickSpacing 60 override the earlier 1.25% prose. A separate immutable 3% token tax applies to transfers from PoolManager except transfers back to PoolManager. Dividends use eligible balances before each net buy, so newly purchased tokens do not earn their own fee. The factory and its registered Merkle distributor are excluded along with PoolManager, the token and burn addresses. The first nonzero factory.distributorOf(launchNumber) observed during transfer is bound permanently; the factory must register it before distributing supply. Fees with no eligible prior holders queue until a later taxed buy with eligible prior holders. ERC-6909-only trades do not trigger token transfers or tax; PoolManager liquidity withdrawals do. Routers must check the recipient balance change. initialPrice is provenance for sorted currencies when SIMDTEST is currency0: floor(sqrt(2500e18 / 1e27) * 2^96). If the actual deployment sorts SIMDTEST as currency1, the corresponding value is 50108289675009586237282760313921. No deployment address is assumed; the launch factory derives the authoritative sorted opening price. tools/launch_price.py calculates the appropriate orientation given the actual token address. External SIMD creator-fee splitting remains the launch operator's responsibility.
